   110	install is the user's decision — ask before writing any workflow file**:
   111	
   112	| Answer | What to install |
   113	|--------|-----------------|
   114	| No CI publishing | Nothing; `doc-gen` stays a local command. |
   115	| Publish the default branch | `docs.yml` only. |
   116	| Publish and preview pull requests | `docs.yml` and `docs-preview.yml`. |
   117	
   118	Never install `docs-preview.yml` without `docs.yml`: the preview workflow writes only below `pr/<number>/` and
   119	expects the site workflow to own the root of the branch.
   120	
   121	Read the templates from `vendor/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/skills/setup-toolkit-doc-gen/docs.yml` and
   122	`docs-preview.yml` and apply them as `.github/workflows/docs.yml` and `.github/workflows/docs-preview.yml`.
   123	
   124	- `docs.yml` runs on pushes to the default branch: it generates the site and syncs it to the root of the `gh-pages`
   125	  branch, keeping `pr/` and `CNAME`.
   126	- `docs-preview.yml` runs on pull requests: it generates the site in diff mode against the base commit, publishes it
   127	  to `pr/<number>/`, comments the link on the pull request, and removes that directory when the pull request closes.
   128	  Pull requests from forks are skipped, because their token cannot write to the branch.
   129	
   130	Adapt both to the project before applying:
   131	
   132	- Match the workflow PHP version to a version the project supports, and add the lock-file step the project's CI uses
   133	  (for example `cp composer.lock.php-8.4 composer.lock` when the repository keeps one lock file per PHP minor).
   134	- Match the generation command to the project: `vendor/bin/doc-gen --config=doc.yaml` or the Composer script.
   135	- Match the `on.push.branches` entry to the default branch, and `DOCS_BRANCH` to the branch Pages serves.
   136	- Keep the action pins as full commit SHAs with the release tag in a comment, the per-job `contents: write`
   137	  permission, and `pull_request` (never `pull_request_target`) as the preview trigger.
   138	
   139	Set `base_url` in `doc.yaml` to the published address at the same time, because that is what makes a shared link
   140	render as a card: every page then carries its canonical link, its own description, and the Open Graph tags, and the
   141	run draws `assets/og-image.png` from the site title and the project description (needs `ext-gd`; without it the
   142	pages simply carry no image). Add a docs badge to the README that links to the site, the way docs.rs does:
   143	
   144	```markdown
   145	[![docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-<package>-0969da?logo=php&logoColor=white)](https://<owner>.github.io/<repository>/)
   146	```
   147	
   148	Close the loop the other way too: the site links back to the repository from every page, reading the address from
   149	`support.source` (then `homepage`) in the package's `composer.json`. Add those entries where the project declares
   150	neither — `support.docs` and `homepage` can point at the published site — and set `repository` in `doc.yaml` only to
   151	override what the manifests declare.
   152	
   153	Tell the user about the one-time repository setup the workflows do not do:
   154	
   155	```bash
   156	git switch --orphan gh-pages
   157	git commit --allow-empty -m 'docs: create the documentation branch'
   158	git push -u origin gh-pages
   159	git switch main
   160	```
   161	
   162	Then set Settings > Pages > Build and deployment > Source to "Deploy from a branch", branch `gh-pages`, folder
   163	`/ (root)`. The site is served at `https://<owner>.github.io/<repository>/`, and previews at
   164	`https://<owner>.github.io/<repository>/pr/<number>/`.
   165	
   166	## Verification
   167	
   168	After applying:
   169	
   170	```bash
   171	vendor/bin/doc-gen --config=doc.yaml
   172	```
   173	
   174	Exit codes:
   175	
   176	- `0`: documentation generated
   177	- `2`: configuration or runtime error
   178	
   179	Then preview locally with `vendor/bin/doc-gen --serve` and spot-check the index page, one class page, and search.
   180	
   181	When a workflow was installed, check it too, and say plainly that the publishing itself is only observable after the
   182	workflow runs on the default branch:
   183	
   184	```bash
   185	go run github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@latest .github/workflows/docs.yml
   186	```
   187	
   188	## References
   189	
   190	- [DocGen Configuration](vendor/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/docs/doc-gen.md) — Settings, scope semantics, caching, publishing, and CLI behavior.
   191	- [GitHub Actions Configuration](vendor/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/docs/github-actions.md) — Workflow hardening rules the documentation workflows follow.

1	# Publishes the DocGen site of the default branch to GitHub Pages.
     2	#
     3	# One-time setup in the repository:
     4	#   1. Create the empty documentation branch:
     5	#        git switch --orphan gh-pages
     6	#        git commit --allow-empty -m 'docs: create the documentation branch'
     7	#        git push -u origin gh-pages
     8	#        git switch main
     9	#   2. Settings > Pages > Build and deployment > Source: "Deploy from a branch",
    10	#      branch "gh-pages", folder "/ (root)".
    11	#
    12	# The site owns the root of that branch: everything else there is replaced on
    13	# every run, except `pr/` (previews written by docs-preview.yml) and `CNAME`
    14	# (a custom Pages domain).
    15	name: Docs
    16	
    17	on:
    18	  push:
    19	    branches:
    20	      - main
    21	  workflow_dispatch:
    22	
    23	permissions:
    24	  contents: read
    25	
    26	concurrency:
    27	  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
    28	  cancel-in-progress: false
    29	
    30	env:
    31	  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
    32	  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages
    33	
    34	jobs:
    35	  publish:
    36	    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    37	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    38	    timeout-minutes: 30
    39	    permissions:
    40	      contents: write
    41	    steps:
    42	      - name: Check out the repository
    43	        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
    44	
    45	      - name: Set up PHP
    46	        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
    47	        with:
    48	          php-version: '8.4'
    49	          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
    50	          # pcov, not none, when the site should link every method to the test
    51	          # cases covering it — that needs a --coverage-xml report, and pcov is
    52	          # several times faster than Xdebug at producing one. Leave this at
    53	          # `none` and drop the coverage step below when it should not.
    54	          coverage: pcov
    55	
    56	      - name: Install dependencies
    57	        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
    58	        with:
    59	          dependency-versions: locked
    60	          composer-options: --prefer-dist
    61	
    62	      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
    63	        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
    64	        with:
    65	          path: build/doc-gen-cache
    66	          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
    67	          restore-keys: |
    68	            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
    69	            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-
    70	
    71	      # The report the `coverage` key in doc.yaml points at. A strict PHPUnit
    72	      # configuration reports a test that executes an undeclared class as
    73	      # risky, so this step is also what keeps the project's #[CoversClass] and
    74	      # #[UsesClass] metadata honest. Drop it, and the `coverage` key, when the
    75	      # site should not carry per-method test references.
    76	      - name: Generate the coverage report the site reads
    77	        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-xml build/coverage-xml
    78	
    79	      - name: Generate the documentation
    80	        run: vendor/bin/doc-gen --config=doc.yaml
    81	
    82	      - name: Check out the documentation branch
    83	        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
    84	        with:
    85	          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
    86	          path: .docs-branch
    87	
    88	      - name: Publish the site
    89	        working-directory: .docs-branch
    90	        run: |
    91	          set -euo pipefail
    92	
    93	          # The site owns the root of the branch; the pull request previews
    94	          # under pr/ and a custom Pages domain in CNAME are kept.
    95	          rsync -a --checksum --delete --exclude '/.git/' --exclude '/pr/' --exclude '/CNAME' ../build/docs/ ./
    96	
    97	          git add --all
    98	          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
    99	            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this documentation."
   100	            exit 0
   101	          fi
   102	
   103	          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
   104	            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
   105	            commit --message "docs: generate from ${GITHUB_SHA}"
   106	          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

     3	  - 'packages/*'
     4	
     5	vendor: []
     6	
     7	vendor_dev: []
     8	
     9	exclude: []
    10	
    11	output: build/docs
    12	
    13	cache: build/doc-gen-cache
    14	
    15	coverage: null
    16	
    17	base_url: null
    18	
    19	repository: null

1	# Publishes a per-pull-request DocGen preview, generated in diff mode against
     2	# the base branch, under `pr/<number>/` of the documentation branch, and links
     3	# it from the pull request. Closing the pull request removes it again.
     4	#
     5	# Requires docs.yml (or an equivalent) to own the root of that branch: this
     6	# workflow only ever writes below `pr/<number>/`.
     7	#
     8	# Pull requests from forks are skipped: they run with a read-only token, so
     9	# they cannot write to the branch or comment. Publishing those needs the
    10	# hardened `workflow_run` pattern — build on `pull_request` and upload an
    11	# artifact, then publish it from a workflow that runs on the default branch.
    12	# Never switch this workflow to `pull_request_target`; that would run
    13	# untrusted code with a write token.
    14	name: Docs Preview
    15	
    16	on:
    17	  pull_request:
    18	    types:
    19	      - opened
    20	      - synchronize
    21	      - reopened
    22	      - closed
    23	
    24	permissions:
    25	  contents: read
    26	
    27	concurrency:
    28	  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
    29	  cancel-in-progress: true
    30	
    31	env:
    32	  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
    33	  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages
    34	
    35	jobs:
    36	  preview:
    37	    name: Generate and publish the pull request preview
    38	    if: github.event.action != 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    39	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    40	    timeout-minutes: 30
    41	    permissions:
    42	      contents: write
    43	      pull-requests: write
    44	    steps:
    45	      # Diff mode checks the base revision out into a temporary worktree, so
    46	      # the history of both revisions has to be present.
    47	      - name: Check out the pull request
    48	        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
    49	        with:
    50	          fetch-depth: 0
    51	
    52	      - name: Set up PHP
    53	        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
    54	        with:
    55	          php-version: '8.4'
    56	          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
    57	          coverage: none
    58	
    59	      - name: Install dependencies
    60	        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
    61	        with:
    62	          dependency-versions: locked
    63	          composer-options: --prefer-dist
    64	
    65	      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
    66	        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
    67	        with:
    68	          path: build/doc-gen-cache
    69	          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
    70	          restore-keys: |
    71	            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
    72	            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-
    73	
    74	      # The checkout is the merge of the pull request into its base, so
    75	      # comparing it against the base commit is what the pull request changes.
    76	      - name: Generate the documentation in diff mode
    77	        env:
    78	          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
    79	          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
    80	        run: |
    81	          set -euo pipefail
    82	
    83	          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
    84	          vendor/bin/doc-gen --config=doc.yaml --diff="${BASE_SHA}" \
    85	            --base-url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
    86	
    87	      - name: Check out the documentation branch
    88	        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
    89	        with:
    90	          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
    91	          path: .docs-branch
    92	
    93	      - name: Publish the preview
    94	        working-directory: .docs-branch
    95	        env:
    96	          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
    97	          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
    98	        run: |
    99	          set -euo pipefail
   100	
   101	          mkdir -p "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
   102	          rsync -a --checksum --delete ../build/docs/ "pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
   103	          # Jekyll is disabled for the whole site from its root, which the
   104	          # preview may reach before the site itself has been published.
   105	          touch .nojekyll
   106	
   107	          git add --all
   108	          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
   109	            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this preview."
   110	            exit 0
   111	          fi
   112	
   113	          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
   114	            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
   115	            commit --message "docs: preview pull request #${PR_NUMBER} at ${HEAD_SHA}"
   116	          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"
   117	
   118	      - name: Comment the preview link on the pull request
   119	        env:
   120	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
   121	          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
   122	          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
   123	          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
   124	        run: |
   125	          set -euo pipefail
   126	
   127	          # Replace this with the site address when Pages serves a custom domain.
   128	          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
   129	          preview_url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
   130	
   131	          gh pr comment "${PR_NUMBER}" --edit-last --create-if-none --body \
   132	          "**Documentation preview:** ${preview_url}
   133	
   134	          Generated in diff mode against \`${BASE_REF}\`, so every page marks what this pull
   135	          request adds, removes, and changes; the display-mode switch next to the theme
   136	          toggle shows the plain documentation, the marked documentation, or the changes
   137	          alone.
   138	
   139	          Updated for ${HEAD_SHA}. The preview is removed when this pull request is closed."
   140	
   141	  cleanup:
   142	    name: Remove the pull request preview
   143	    if: github.event.action == 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
   144	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   145	    timeout-minutes: 10
   146	    permissions:
   147	      contents: write
   148	      pull-requests: write
   149	    steps:
   150	      - name: Check out the documentation branch
   151	        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
   152	        with:
   153	          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
   154	
   155	      - name: Remove the preview
   156	        env:
   157	          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
   158	        run: |
   159	          set -euo pipefail
   160	
   161	          rm -rf "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
   162	
   163	          git add --all
   164	          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
   165	            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch carries no preview of this pull request."
   166	            exit 0
   167	          fi
   168	
   169	          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
   170	            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
   171	            commit --message "docs: remove the preview of pull request #${PR_NUMBER}"
   172	          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"
   173	
   174	      - name: Note the removal on the pull request
   175	        env:
   176	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
   177	          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
   178	        run: |
   179	          gh pr comment "${PR_NUMBER}" --edit-last --body \
   180	            'The documentation preview of this pull request has been removed.' \
   181	            || echo 'This pull request has no preview comment.'

#[CoversClass(DocGenCliArgumentParser::class)]
#[UsesClass(DocGenException::class)]
final class DocGenCliArgumentParserTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testParseReturnsInactiveDefaults(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(
            ['config' => null, 'output' => null, 'vendor' => null, 'vendorDev' => null, 'coverage' => null, 'baseUrl' => null, 'serve' => null, 'memoryLimit' => null, 'jobs' => null, 'base' => null, 'head' => null, 'cacheDir' => null, 'noCache' => false, 'clearCache' => false, 'help' => false, 'version' => false],
            (new DocGenCliArgumentParser())->parse([]),
        );
    }

    public function testParseReadsDiffRangeAsBaseAndHead(): void
    {
        $options = (new DocGenCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--diff=main..HEAD']);

        self::assertSame('main', $options['base']);
        self::assertSame('HEAD', $options['head']);
    }

    public function testParseReadsDiffWithoutHeadAsWorkingTreeComparison(): void
    {
        $options = (new DocGenCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--diff', 'v1.0.0']);

        self::assertSame('v1.0.0', $options['base']);
        self::assertNull($options['head']);
    }

    public function testParseReadsSeparateBaseAndHeadOptions(): void
    {
        $options = (new DocGenCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--base=main', '--head', 'feature']);

        self::assertSame('main', $options['base']);
        self::assertSame('feature', $options['head']);
    }

    public function testParseRejectsHeadWithoutBase(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(DocGenException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Option --head needs a revision to compare against: add --base=REVISION, or use --diff=BASE..HEAD.');

        (new DocGenCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--head=HEAD']);
    }

    public function testParseRejectsDiffRangeWithoutBaseRevision(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(DocGenException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Invalid --diff range: ..HEAD. Use BASE to compare against the working tree, or BASE..HEAD to compare two revisions.');

        (new DocGenCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--diff=..HEAD']);
    }

    public function testIsValueOptionRecognizesEveryOptionThatCarriesAValue(): void
    {
        $parser = new DocGenCliArgumentParser();

        self::assertTrue($parser->isValueOption('--diff'));
        self::assertTrue($parser->isValueOption('--base=main'));
        self::assertTrue($parser->isValueOption('--head=HEAD'));
        self::assertTrue($parser->isValueOption('--output=build'));
        self::assertTrue($parser->isValueOption('--memory-limit'));
        self::assertFalse($parser->isValueOption('--serve'));
        self::assertFalse($parser->isValueOption('--diffuse'));
    }

    public function testOptionNameStripsThePrefixAndTheInlineValue(): void
    {
        $parser = new DocGenCliArgumentParser();

        self::assertSame('diff', $parser->optionName('--diff=main..HEAD'));
        self::assertSame('base', $parser->optionName('--base'));
    }

    public function testApplyValueOptionAssignsEveryValueOption(): void
    {
        $parser = new DocGenCliArgumentParser();
        $defaults = $parser->parse([]);

        self::assertSame('doc.yaml', $parser->applyValueOption($defaults, 'config', 'doc.yaml')['config']);
        self::assertSame('build/site', $parser->applyValueOption($defaults, 'output', 'build/site')['output']);
        self::assertSame('build/cov', $parser->applyValueOption($defaults, 'coverage', 'build/cov')['coverage']);
        self::assertSame('1G', $parser->applyValueOption($defaults, 'memory-limit', '1G')['memoryLimit']);
        self::assertSame('main', $parser->applyValueOption($defaults, 'base', 'main')['base']);
        self::assertSame('HEAD', $parser->applyValueOption($defaults, 'head', 'HEAD')['head']);
        self::assertSame('v2', $parser->applyValueOption($defaults, 'diff', 'v1..v2')['head']);
    }

    public function testRevisionRangeKeepsAnEarlierHeadWhenTheRangeOmitsOne(): void
    {
        $parser = new DocGenCliArgumentParser();
        $options = $parser->parse(['--head=feature', '--base=main']);

        self::assertSame('feature', $parser->revisionRange($options, 'v1.0.0')['head']);
        self::assertSame('v1.0.0', $parser->revisionRange($options, 'v1.0.0')['base']);
    }

    public function testValidatedAcceptsABaseWithoutAHead(): void
    {
        $parser = new DocGenCliArgumentParser();

        self::assertSame('main', $parser->validated($parser->parse(['--base=main']))['base']);
    }

    public function testParseRecognizesHelpOptions(): void
    {
        self::assertTrue((new DocGenCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--help'])['help']);
        self::assertTrue((new DocGenCliArgumentParser())->parse(['-h'])['help']);
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace PhpAiToolkit\DocGen\Config;

/**
 * Immutable DocGen configuration loaded from doc.yaml.
 *
 * The configuration deliberately covers only the documented code scope and
 * the output location; page content and design are fixed by the generator.
 *
 * @property-read string $root
 * @property-read list<string> $packages
 * @property-read list<string> $vendor
 * @property-read list<string> $exclude
 * @property-read string $output
 * @property-read ?string $title
 * @property-read ?string $deptrac
 * @property-read ?string $coverage
 * @property-read list<string> $vendorDev
 * @property-read ?string $cache
 * @property-read ?string $baseUrl
 * @property-read ?string $repository
 */
final class DocGenConfig
{
    /**
     * Where the generation caches are kept unless a project says otherwise.
     */
    public const DEFAULT_CACHE = 'build/doc-gen-cache';

    /**
     * @param list<string> $packages
     * @param list<string> $vendor package name globs for installed runtime dependencies
     * @param list<string> $exclude
     * @param list<string> $vendorDev package name globs for installed dev dependencies
     * @param ?string $cache the cache directory, or null to cache nothing
     * @param ?string $baseUrl the address the site is published at, without a trailing slash, or null when it is unknown
     * @param ?string $repository the address of the repository the project lives in, or null to read it from the root package
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private string $root,
        /** @readonly */
        private array $packages,
        /** @readonly */
        private array $vendor,
        /** @readonly */
        private array $exclude,
        /** @readonly */
        private string $output,
        /** @readonly */
        private ?string $title,
        /** @readonly */
        private ?string $deptrac,
        /** @readonly */
        private ?string $coverage,
        /** @readonly */
        private array $vendorDev = [],
        /** @readonly */
        private ?string $cache = self::DEFAULT_CACHE,
        /** @readonly */
        private ?string $baseUrl = null,
        /** @readonly */
        private ?string $repository = null,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Provides read-only access to the immutable properties.
     *
     * @return mixed the value of the requested property
     */
    public function __get(string $name): mixed
    {
        return match ($name) {
            'root' => $this->root,
            'packages' => $this->packages,
            'vendor' => $this->vendor,
            'exclude' => $this->exclude,
            'output' => $this->output,
            'title' => $this->title,
            'deptrac' => $this->deptrac,
            'coverage' => $this->coverage,
            'vendorDev' => $this->vendorDev,
            'cache' => $this->cache,
            'baseUrl' => $this->baseUrl,
            'repository' => $this->repository,
            default => null,
        };
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace PhpAiToolkit\DocGen\Cli;

use function array_shift;

use Closure;
use PhpAiToolkit\DocGen\DocGenException;

use function sprintf;

/**
 * CLI entry point for DocGen.
 */
final class Application
{
    private const VERSION = '1.0.0';

    /** @readonly */
    private DocGenOutputWriter $writer;

    /** @readonly */
    private DocGenCliArgumentParser $argumentParser;

    /** @readonly */
    private DocGenHelpText $helpText;

    /** @readonly */
    private DocGenGenerationRunner $generationRunner;

    /**
     * Creates the DocGen CLI application for a project working directory.
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private string $workingDirectory,
        ?Closure $stdout = null,
        ?Closure $stderr = null,
        ?DocGenCliArgumentParser $argumentParser = null,
        ?DocGenHelpText $helpText = null,
        ?DocGenGenerationRunner $generationRunner = null,
    ) {
        $this->writer = new DocGenOutputWriter($stdout, $stderr);
        $this->argumentParser = $argumentParser ?? new DocGenCliArgumentParser();
        $this->helpText = $helpText ?? new DocGenHelpText();
        $this->generationRunner = $generationRunner ?? new DocGenGenerationRunner(
            $this->workingDirectory,
            null,
            null,
            null,
            $this->writer,
        );
    }

    /**
     * Runs the CLI with raw process arguments.
     *
     * @param list<string> $argv
     */
    public function run(array $argv): int
    {
        array_shift($argv);
        try {
            $arguments = $this->argumentParser->parse($argv);
        } catch (DocGenException $exception) {
            $this->writer->writeError(sprintf("DocGen error: %s\n", $exception->getMessage()));

            return 2;
        }

        if ($arguments['help']) {
            $this->writer->write($this->helpText->text());

            return 0;
        }

        if ($arguments['version']) {
            $this->writer->write(sprintf("doc-gen %s\n", self::VERSION));

            return 0;
        }

        return $this->generationRunner->run($arguments);
    }
}

final class TreeGuardCliArgumentParserTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testParseAppliesDefaults(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(
            ['packages' => null, 'vendor' => null, 'vendorDev' => null, 'exclude' => null, 'output' => null, 'title' => null, 'deptrac' => null, 'coverage' => null, 'cacheDir' => null, 'baseUrl' => null, 'repository' => null, 'serve' => null, 'memoryLimit' => null, 'jobs' => null, 'base' => null, 'head' => null, 'noCache' => false, 'clearCache' => false, 'help' => false, 'version' => false],
            (new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse([]),
        );
    }

    public function testParseReadsHelpAndVersionFlags(): void
    {
        self::assertTrue((new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--help'])['help']);
        self::assertTrue((new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['-h'])['help']);
        self::assertTrue((new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--version'])['version']);
        self::assertTrue((new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['-V'])['version']);
    }

    public function testParseReadsConfigOptionForms(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('a.yaml', (new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--config', 'a.yaml'])['config']);
        self::assertSame('b.yaml', (new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--config=b.yaml'])['config']);
    }

    public function testParseReadsReporterOptionForms(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('json', (new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--reporter', 'json'])['reporter']);
        self::assertSame('text', (new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--reporter=text'])['reporter']);
        self::assertSame('ai', (new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--format', 'ai'])['reporter']);
        self::assertSame('json', (new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--format=json'])['reporter']);
    }

    public function testParseRejectsUnknownOption(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(TreeGuardException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Unknown option: --unknown');

        (new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--unknown']);
    }

    public function testParseRejectsMissingConfigValue(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(TreeGuardException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Missing value for --config.');

        (new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--config']);
    }

    public function testParseRejectsMissingReporterValueBeforeNextOption(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(TreeGuardException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Missing value for --reporter.');

        (new TreeGuardCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--reporter', '--config']);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\DocGen\Cli;

use PhpAiToolkit\DocGen\Cli\DocGenCliArgumentParser;
use PhpAiToolkit\DocGen\Cli\DocGenConfigFactory;
use PhpAiToolkit\DocGen\Config\BaseUrl;
use PhpAiToolkit\DocGen\Config\DocGenConfig;
use PhpAiToolkit\DocGen\Config\RepositoryUrl;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

#[CoversClass(DocGenConfigFactory::class)]
#[UsesClass(BaseUrl::class)]
#[UsesClass(DocGenCliArgumentParser::class)]
#[UsesClass(DocGenConfig::class)]
#[UsesClass(RepositoryUrl::class)]
final class DocGenConfigFactoryTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testCreateReadsEveryOptionOfTheRun(): void
    {
        $arguments = (new DocGenCliArgumentParser())->parse([
            '--packages=.,packages/*',
            '--vendor=acme/*',
            '--vendor-dev=phpunit/*',
            '--exclude=tests/Fixture/*',
            '--output=public/site',
            '--title=Demo Docs',
            '--deptrac=conf/deptrac.yaml',
            '--coverage=build/coverage-xml',
            '--cache-dir=.docgen',
            '--base-url=https://example.github.io/project',
            '--repository=https://github.com/example/project',
        ]);

        $config = (new DocGenConfigFactory())->create(sys_get_temp_dir(), $arguments);

        self::assertSame(realpath(sys_get_temp_dir()), $config->root);
        self::assertSame(['.', 'packages/*'], $config->packages);
        self::assertSame(['acme/*'], $config->vendor);
        self::assertSame(['phpunit/*'], $config->vendorDev);
        self::assertSame(['tests/Fixture/*'], $config->exclude);
        self::assertSame('public/site', $config->output);
        self::assertSame('Demo Docs', $config->title);
        self::assertSame('conf/deptrac.yaml', $config->deptrac);
        self::assertSame('build/coverage-xml', $config->coverage);
        self::assertSame('.docgen', $config->cache);
        self::assertSame('https://example.github.io/project', $config->baseUrl);
        self::assertSame('https://github.com/example/project', $config->repository);
    }

    public function testCreateFallsBackToTheDefaultsOfARunWithoutOptions(): void
    {
        $config = (new DocGenConfigFactory())->create(sys_get_temp_dir(), (new DocGenCliArgumentParser())->parse([]));

        self::assertSame(['.', 'packages/*'], $config->packages);
        self::assertSame([], $config->vendor);
        self::assertSame([], $config->vendorDev);
        self::assertSame([], $config->exclude);
        self::assertSame('build/docs', $config->output);
        self::assertSame('build/doc-gen-cache', $config->cache);
        self::assertNull($config->title);
        self::assertNull($config->deptrac);
        self::assertNull($config->coverage);
        self::assertNull($config->baseUrl);
        self::assertNull($config->repository);
    }

    public function testCreateKeepsTheWorkingDirectoryThatCannotBeResolved(): void
    {
        $config = (new DocGenConfigFactory())->create('/no/such/project', (new DocGenCliArgumentParser())->parse([]));

        self::assertSame('/no/such/project', $config->root);
    }

    public function testCacheIsTheDirectoryOfTheRunUnlessItCachesNothing(): void
    {
        $parser = new DocGenCliArgumentParser();
        $factory = new DocGenConfigFactory();

        self::assertSame('build/doc-gen-cache', $factory->cache($parser->parse([])));
        self::assertSame('.docgen', $factory->cache($parser->parse(['--cache-dir=.docgen'])));
        self::assertNull($factory->cache($parser->parse(['--no-cache'])));
        self::assertNull($factory->cache($parser->parse(['--no-cache', '--cache-dir=.docgen'])));
    }

    public function testCacheDirectoryNamesWhatARunClearsEvenWhenItCachesNothing(): void
    {
        $parser = new DocGenCliArgumentParser();
        $factory = new DocGenConfigFactory();

        self::assertSame('build/doc-gen-cache', $factory->cacheDirectory($parser->parse([])));
        self::assertSame('.docgen', $factory->cacheDirectory($parser->parse(['--no-cache', '--cache-dir=.docgen'])));
    }

    public function testCreateTurnsTheCacheOffForARunThatAskedFor(): void
    {
        $config = (new DocGenConfigFactory())->create(sys_get_temp_dir(), (new DocGenCliArgumentParser())->parse(['--no-cache']));

        self::assertNull($config->cache);
    }
}

# Generates the DocGen site and publishes it to the gh-pages branch, which
# GitHub Pages serves at https://k-kinzal.github.io/php-ai-toolkit/.
# See docs/doc-gen.md for the publishing model and the pull request preview
# workflow this repository does not run.
name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          # The site links every method to the test cases covering it, which
          # needs a coverage report. pcov is several times faster than Xdebug
          # and produces the same --coverage-xml.
          coverage: pcov

      - name: Select the matching lock file
        run: cp composer.lock.php-8.4 composer.lock

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/doc-gen-cache
          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock.php-8.4') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock.php-8.4') }}-
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate the coverage report the site reads
        run: composer test:coverage

      - name: Generate the documentation
        run: composer doc-gen

      - name: Check out the documentation branch

1	# Publishes a per-pull-request DocGen preview, generated in diff mode against
2	# the base branch, under `pr/<number>/` of the documentation branch, and links
3	# it from the pull request. Closing the pull request removes it again.
4	#
5	# Requires docs.yml (or an equivalent) to own the root of that branch: this
6	# workflow only ever writes below `pr/<number>/`.
7	#
8	# Pull requests from forks are skipped: they run with a read-only token, so
9	# they cannot write to the branch or comment. Publishing those needs the
10	# hardened `workflow_run` pattern — build on `pull_request` and upload an
11	# artifact, then publish it from a workflow that runs on the default branch.
12	# Never switch this workflow to `pull_request_target`; that would run
13	# untrusted code with a write token.
14	name: Docs Preview
15	
16	on:
17	  pull_request:
18	    types:
19	      - opened
20	      - synchronize
21	      - reopened
22	      - closed
23	
24	permissions:
25	  contents: read
26	
27	concurrency:
28	  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
29	  cancel-in-progress: true
30	
31	env:
32	  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
33	  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages
34	
35	jobs:
36	  preview:
37	    name: Generate and publish the pull request preview
38	    if: github.event.action != 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
39	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
40	    timeout-minutes: 30
41	    permissions:
42	      contents: write
43	      pull-requests: write
44	    steps:
45	      # Diff mode checks the base revision out into a temporary worktree, so
46	      # the history of both revisions has to be present.
47	      - name: Check out the pull request
48	        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
49	        with:
50	          fetch-depth: 0
51	
52	      - name: Set up PHP
53	        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
54	        with:
55	          php-version: '8.4'
56	          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
57	          coverage: none
58	
59	      - name: Install dependencies
60	        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
61	        with:
62	          dependency-versions: locked

65	      - name: Restore the DocGen cache

67	        with:
68	          path: build/doc-gen-cache

70	          restore-keys: |
71	            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
72	            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-
73	
74	      # The checkout is the merge of the pull request into its base, so
75	      # comparing it against the base commit is what the pull request changes.
76	      - name: Generate the documentation in diff mode
77	        env:
78	          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
79	          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
80	        run: |
81	          set -euo pipefail

86

89	        with:

91	          path: .docs-branch
92	
93	      - name: Publish the preview
94	        working-directory: .docs-branch
95	        env:
96	          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
97	          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
98	        run: |
99	          set -euo pipefail
100	
101	          mkdir -p "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
102	          rsync -a --checksum --delete ../build/docs/ "pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
103	          # Jekyll is disabled for the whole site from its root, which the
104	          # preview may reach before the site itself has been published.
105	          touch .nojekyll
106	
107	          git add --all
108	          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
109	            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this preview."
110	            exit 0
111	          fi
112	
113	          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \

116	          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"
117

130

132	          "**Documentation preview:** ${preview_url}
133	
134	          Generated in diff mode against \`${BASE_REF}\`, so every page marks what this pull
135	          request adds, removes, and changes; the display-mode switch next to the theme
136	          toggle shows the plain documentation, the marked documentation, or the changes

138	
139	          Updated for ${HEAD_SHA}. The preview is removed when this pull request is closed."
140	
141	  cleanup:
142	    name: Remove the pull request preview
143	    if: github.event.action == 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
144	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
145	    timeout-minutes: 10

150	      - name: Check out the documentation branch
151	        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
152	        with:
153	          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}

172	          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"
173

36	
37	## Configuration
38	
39	**DocGen has no configuration file.** A run is configured by its options alone, so the command that generated a site
40	is the whole description of that site — which is what lets a CI job pass the values only it knows, such as the
41	address the site is published at. Write the project's own settings into a Composer script, and leave the rest to the
42	job that calls it.
43	
44	| Option | Default | Meaning |
45	|--------|---------|---------|
46	| `--packages=GLOBS` | `.` and `packages/*` | Directory globs probed for a `composer.json`; each hit becomes a documented package. |
47	| `--vendor[=GLOBS]` | none | Composer package-name globs (`acme/*`, not directory names) of installed **runtime** dependencies to document alongside the project; bare `--vendor` means all of them. |
48	| `--vendor-dev[=GLOBS]` | none | The same for installed **dev** dependencies; leave it off unless the test tooling itself needs documenting. |
49	| `--exclude=GLOBS` | none | Path globs, relative to the project root, pruned from source scanning. |
50	| `--output=DIR` | `build/docs` | Site output directory. |
51	| `--title=TEXT` | the root package name | Site title. |
52	| `--deptrac=FILE` | `deptrac.yaml` when present | Deptrac configuration the architecture graph and the layer badges are read from. |
53	| `--coverage=DIR` | none | PHPUnit `--coverage-xml` report directory; links every method to the test cases covering it. |
54	| `--base-url=URL` | none | Absolute address the site is published at, without a trailing slash. Pass it where the site is published from; it is what the canonical links and the social preview are written from. |
55	| `--repository=URL` | what the root `composer.json` declares | Absolute address of the repository the project lives in, which every page links back to. Pass it only to override `support.source` or `homepage`. |
56	| `--cache-dir=DIR` | `build/doc-gen-cache` | Directory the parsed sources and written pages are remembered in; `--no-cache` turns caching off for one run. Keep it outside the output directory. |
57	
58	Every option that takes `GLOBS` reads a comma-separated list and may be repeated, which adds to what the earlier
59	occurrences named. `doc-gen --help` lists these together with the run options (`--jobs`, `--memory-limit`,
60	`--serve`, `--diff`, `--clear-cache`).
61	
62	## Scope Semantics
63	
64	The documented unit is the composer package: production autoload sources become API pages while `autoload-dev`
65	sources become linkable source pages only, so test references stay navigable without widening the API surface.
66	Page content and design are fixed by the generator on purpose — only the scope is configurable.
67	
68	## Adapting to the Project
69	
70	- Single-package repositories need no `--packages`; the default `packages/*` glob simply matches nothing.
71	- Add `--exclude` globs for fixture directories that contain intentionally invalid PHP (for example
72	  `--exclude=tests/Fixture/*`).
73	- To document key dependencies too, pass specific composer package name globs such as `--vendor=acme/*` rather than
74	  `--vendor`; a glob that documents no installed package of that kind is reported as a warning, so typos surface at
75	  once. Dev tooling is excluded unless a `--vendor-dev` glob asks for it.
76	- Documenting a dependency is what makes its classes link targets in signatures and type expressions, so add the
77	  packages whose types appear in the public API. Packages that ship only a phar cannot be documented and say so in a
78	  warning.
79	- Documenting many vendor packages needs memory: the run raises a limit below 512M automatically, and
80	  `--memory-limit=1G` handles very large dependency trees.
81	- When the project runs deptrac, keep `deptrac.yaml` at the root so the architecture graph appears automatically.
82	- Generate coverage with `--coverage-xml build/coverage-xml` and pass `--coverage=build/coverage-xml` so every method
83	  links the test cases that cover it.
84	- Runs are incremental by default: the next run parses only the sources that changed and rewrites only the pages
85	  that changed, and reports what it reused (`Cache: 861 of 862 sources and 1365 of 1411 pages reused`). The site is
86	  the same site a full run writes, byte for byte. Use `--no-cache` to prove that on demand, `--clear-cache` to start
87	  over, and `--cache-dir=DIR` to keep the cache elsewhere. Add the cache directory to `.gitignore`.
88	- In CI, restore the cache directory between runs (for example with `actions/cache` keyed on `composer.lock` and the
89	  toolkit version) so a documentation job costs the size of the change rather than the size of the project.
90	- To review what a branch changed, generate the site in diff mode: `--diff=main` compares the working tree against
91	  `main`, `--diff=v1.0.0..HEAD` compares two revisions. The site then marks additions and removals down to the single
92	  argument of a declaration and offers three display modes — the plain documentation, the marked documentation, and
93	  the changes alone. Diff mode needs a git working tree and analyzes both revisions, so it takes about twice as long.
94	
95	## Recommended Composer Scripts
96	
97	Add scripts that match the project:
98	
99	The scripts are where the project's own settings live, because there is no configuration file to keep them in.
100	Write the settings once in `doc-gen`, and let the other scripts add to it:
101	
102	```json
103	{
104	    "scripts": {
105	        "doc-gen": "doc-gen --exclude='tests/Fixture/*' --coverage=build/coverage-xml",
106	        "doc-gen:serve": "@doc-gen --serve",
107	        "doc-gen:diff": "@doc-gen --diff=main --serve",
108	        "doc-gen:fresh": "@doc-gen --no-cache"
109	    }
110	}
111	```
112	
113	Quote a glob that a shell would otherwise expand, as `'tests/Fixture/*'` above. A caller adds to the script's
114	options with `composer doc-gen -- --base-url=https://example.github.io/project`, which is how a CI job passes what
115	only it knows.
116	
117	Do not add `doc-gen` to `lint`; it is a generator, not a check.
118

122	to a branch that GitHub Pages serves. This skill ships two workflow templates for that, and **which of them to
123	install is the user's decision — ask before writing any workflow file**:

7	DocGen is a first-party CLI that generates a complete static HTML documentation site for the composer packages of a

44	when the environment allows less. A higher environment limit is kept as is, and `--memory-limit=1G` or
45	`--memory-limit=-1` overrides both.

48	
49	Both expensive phases run in worker processes: the sources are parsed in parallel, and the symbol and source pages

60	```

63	shared memory is not safe to fill from several forked processes at once. A run without them is sequential rather than
64	failed, and the generated site is byte for byte the same however many workers wrote it: the work is split into
65	consecutive jobs and the results are merged in job order, so nothing about the site depends on which worker finished
66	first.

69	
70	A run remembers two things in its cache directory: what every source file parsed into, and what every page of the
71	site was written from. The next run parses only the files that changed, and rewrites only the pages that changed.

gate only ever runs here, so a wrapper would add a layer to look through and a
second place for the flags to drift. See [Infection Configuration](infection.md).

## Documentation Workflows

`.github/workflows/docs.yml` is separate from `ci.yml` on purpose: it generates
the DocGen site on every push to `main` and publishes it to the `gh-pages`
branch, which needs `contents: write` for that one job while CI stays
read-only. It restores the DocGen cache between runs, so a documentation job
costs the size of the change.

It runs `composer test:coverage` before `composer doc-gen`, and sets up PHP with
`coverage: pcov` to make that possible. `doc.yaml` points `coverage` at
`build/coverage-xml`, which is what lets every method on the site name the test
cases covering it. The step earns its minutes twice over: PHPUnit is configured
with `requireCoverageMetadata` and `beStrictAboutCoverageMetadata`, so a test
that executes a class it did not declare in `#[CoversClass]` or `#[UsesClass]`
is reported as risky and fails the run. Without a coverage run somewhere on
`main`, that metadata drifts unnoticed — the rest of CI never asks for it.

The `/setup-toolkit-doc-gen` skill also ships a pull request preview workflow
(`docs-preview.yml`) that publishes a diff-mode site under `pr/<number>/` of the
same branch and comments the link. This repository does not run it — it is
developed on `main` without pull requests — so it stays a template. See
[DocGen Configuration](doc-gen.md) for the publishing model and the one-time
Pages setup.

## Status Badges

# GitHub Actions Configuration

GitHub Actions configuration generated by the `/setup-toolkit-github-actions`
skill.

## Purpose

The CI workflow makes every php-ai-toolkit gate visible in GitHub Actions while
preserving the project's command model: unit tests run in a `tests` job, and
formatting, PHPStan, PHPCompatibility, LocGuard, TreeGuard, ScopeGuard, Deptrac,
and runtime/package checks run in a `lint` job. Each lint check should appear as
a named step so failures are actionable without reading a long aggregate
`composer lint` log.

Every gate is listed there because a configured gate that CI never runs is worse
than one the project does not have: `composer lint` chains all seven locally, so
the project reads as covered, while on the default branch only the steps that
were written into the workflow actually hold. The `lint` job therefore carries
one step per script in that chain, and adding a guard to `composer lint` means
adding its step here in the same change.

## PHP Version Coverage

`composer.json` declares PHP `^8.0`, so CI covers every supported minor from
PHP 8.0 through 8.5 in both `tests` and `lint`.

Dependency constraints must make that possible. This project allows the older
PHPUnit 9.6 / ParaTest 6 and Deptrac 0.24 lines for PHP 8.0, plus newer tool
lines for newer PHP versions.

Most projects can use a normal single `composer.lock`. This project uses one
committed lock file per PHP minor because it is a developer tool supporting old
PHP versions and the dependency graph differs by runtime. CI copies
`composer.lock.php-8.0` through `composer.lock.php-8.5` to `composer.lock` in
each matching matrix job before Composer validation and install. CI does not
generate alternate Composer manifests or use `--ignore-platform-reqs`.

Refresh PHP-versioned locks without writing `config.platform.php` to the root
`composer.json`: generate each lock in a temporary directory with a temporary
Composer home, then copy it back as `composer.lock.php-<minor>`.

The PHP 8.0 lock pins PHPStan 1.12 instead of 2.x, and is refreshed with
`composer update --with phpstan/phpstan:^1.12`. The only deptrac line that
installs on PHP 8.0 requires nikic/php-parser 4, while the PHPStan 2 phar
bundles php-parser 5 under the same class names: whichever of the two is
autoloaded first wins, so a test that loads both dies with a fatal error.
The PHPStan 1.12 phar bundles php-parser 4 and agrees with the rest of that
graph. `phpstan/phpstan-strict-rules` is therefore required as
`^1.6 || ^2.0`, so both lines resolve.

`composer compat` remains a named step inside the `lint` job alongside
formatting, PHPStan, LocGuard, TreeGuard, ScopeGuard, and Deptrac. See
[PHPCompatibility Configuration](php-compatibility.md).

## Parallel Test Job

The `tests` matrix also covers the documented examples. Doctest is a PHPUnit
extension plus a test suite rather than a separate command, so `phpunit.xml.dist`
carries a `doctest` suite next to `unit` and both run wherever the suite runs —
on every supported PHP minor, with no job of its own. That includes the mutation
job, whose `--no-extensions` is about the AI test reporter rather than about
doctest: the suite reads what to scan from the declaration in `phpunit.xml`
whether or not the extension bootstrapped. See
[Doctest Configuration](doctest.md).

`composer test` runs the suite under ParaTest, and the `tests` matrix does not:
it runs `composer test:unit` (or `test:unit:legacy` on PHP 8.0), which is
PHPUnit in one process. Two runners are configured, so both are run.

`tests-parallel` is a single job rather than a second matrix. The matrix already
answers whether the suite passes on each supported PHP minor; what the parallel
runner adds is whether the suite still passes when it is split across processes
— no two test classes writing the same fixture path, no ordering assumed between
classes, no state carried from one to the next. That property does not depend on
the PHP version, so it is checked once on PHP 8.4, the same way the mutation
score is.

It runs on PHP 8.4 rather than 8.0 because `composer test` passes no
`--configuration` and so reads `phpunit.xml.dist`, the PHPUnit 10+ configuration.
PHP 8.0 resolves PHPUnit 9.6, which needs `phpunit9.xml.dist` — that leg is
covered by `test:unit:legacy` in the matrix.

## Mutation Testing Job

`ci.yml` runs mutation testing in a `mutation` job rather than as a step of `lint`,
because it needs a coverage driver, a full-depth checkout, and minutes rather than
seconds. It is not a matrix: the mutation score does not depend on the PHP version,
so it is scored once on PHP 8.4 while the `tests` matrix covers the rest. The job
picks its gate from the event — one step scores the lines a pull request changed
against stricter thresholds, the other scores the whole source tree on `main`. Its
commands are written into the workflow rather than wrapped in Composer scripts: the
gate only ever runs here, so a wrapper would add a layer to look through and a
second place for the flags to drift. See [Infection Configuration](infection.md).

## Documentation Workflows

`.github/workflows/docs.yml` is separate from `ci.yml` on purpose: it generates
the DocGen site on every push to `main` and publishes it to the `gh-pages`
branch, which needs `contents: write` for that one job while CI stays
read-only. It restores the DocGen cache between runs, so a documentation job
costs the size of the change.

It runs `composer test:coverage` before `composer doc-gen`, and sets up PHP with
`coverage: pcov` to make that possible. `doc.yaml` points `coverage` at
`build/coverage-xml`, which is what lets every method on the site name the test
cases covering it. The step earns its minutes twice over: PHPUnit is configured
with `requireCoverageMetadata` and `beStrictAboutCoverageMetadata`, so a test
that executes a class it did not declare in `#[CoversClass]` or `#[UsesClass]`
is reported as risky and fails the run. Without a coverage run somewhere on
`main`, that metadata drifts unnoticed — the rest of CI never asks for it.

The `/setup-toolkit-doc-gen` skill also ships a pull request preview workflow
(`docs-preview.yml`) that publishes a diff-mode site under `pr/<number>/` of the
same branch and comments the link. This repository does not run it — it is
developed on `main` without pull requests — so it stays a template. See
[DocGen Configuration](doc-gen.md) for the publishing model and the one-time
Pages setup.

## Status Badges

Both workflows carry a `name` (`CI` and `Docs`) because the README status
badges take their label from it: an unnamed workflow renders as its own file
path. The badges point at
`https://github.com/<owner>/<repository>/actions/workflows/<file>/badge.svg?branch=main`,
so they report the state of `main` rather than of whatever ran last, and each
one links to its workflow's run history.

## Workflow Hardening

Actions must be pinned to full 40-character commit SHAs, with the release tag
kept as a comment. The workflow should use least-privilege permissions,
concurrency cancellation, job timeouts, named jobs and steps, and `fail-fast:
false` on matrices.

DocGen の設定ファイル方式を機能ごと廃止しました。`URL` の話から対象は DocGen（`doc.yaml` の `base_url`）と判断しています。LocGuard/TreeGuard/ScopeGuard の `--config=*.yaml` はしきい値や命名規則といった CI から渡す性質でない設定なので触っていません（そちらも落とす意図なら言ってください）。

**CLI（`doc-gen`）**
- `--config` を削除。設定は全部オプションで指定する形に統一
- 追加: `--packages`, `--exclude`, `--title`, `--deptrac`, `--repository`（既存の `--output` `--vendor` `--vendor-dev` `--coverage` `--base-url` `--cache-dir` `--no-cache` と合わせて旧 `doc.yaml` の全キーを網羅）
- GLOBS 系はカンマ区切り＋繰り返し可（繰り返すと追加される）ので、Composer スクリプトが書いた分に CI が足せます
- 旧 `cache: false` は `--no-cache` に対応。エラーメッセージも `Invalid --base-url value: …` のようにオプション名を名指しする形へ

**削除/追加したクラス**
- 削除: `ConfigLoader`, `ConfigScalarReader`, `ConfigStringListReader`, `DocGenConfigPathResolver`, `DocGenConfigOverrides`（＋各テスト）
- 追加: `DocGenConfigFactory`（引数から `DocGenConfig` を組み立てる）。`DocGenGenerationRunner` は YAML を一切読まなくなり、`DocGenHelpText` はオプション群を scope/site/diff に分割

**リポジトリ側**
- ルートの `doc.yaml` とスキルのテンプレート `doc.yaml` を削除
- `composer doc-gen` = `bin/doc-gen --packages=. --exclude='tests/Fixture/*' --coverage=build/coverage-xml`
- `.github/workflows/docs.yml` は `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` から導出した `--base-url` を `composer doc-gen -- …` で渡す（プレビュー用テンプレートも同様に `--config` を落とし済み）
- `docs/doc-gen.md`（「Configuration」→「Options」）、`docs/github-actions.md`、`skills/setup-toolkit-doc-gen/SKILL.md`・両ワークフローテンプレートを追随

**確認**
- `composer lint` 0（php-cs-fixer / PHPStan max / phpcs / loc-guard / tree-guard / scope-guard / deptrac）
- `composer test:unit`（unit + doctest）パス
- 実生成も確認: `composer doc-gen -- --base-url=…` で 1756 ページ生成、`og:url` に base-url が入り、`tests/Fixture` は除外済み

コミットはしていません。`main` に直接コミットしてよければ言ってください。

content.content:
=== c65f62e
Read the doctest configuration out of phpunit.xml, not out of the bootstrap order

Four things the port carried that only some of the supported PHPUnit lines
tolerate. Each turned a job red on a version the others do not run.

The suite got its configuration from the extension's bootstrap() and nothing
else. PHPUnit 10.5 builds the test suite before it bootstraps extensions, and a
data provider is resolved while the suite is built, so on that line the provider
asked for a configuration nobody had stored yet, discovered nothing, and PHPUnit
failed the run over an empty data set. --no-extensions ends the same way, which
is how the mutation job's coverage step failed. So getConfiguration() falls back
to reading what the <bootstrap> element declares: the same parameters PHPUnit
would have handed bootstrap(), available whenever the suite asks. Sixteen
examples now run on 9.6, 10.5, 11.5, 12.5, and 13, with extensions and without.
Switching them off is what `enabled="false"` is for, and the docs say so now
instead of describing --no-extensions as the way.

The extension test named PHPUnit\Runner\Extension\ExtensionFacade, which only
PHPUnit 13 ships — 10 through 12 have Facade as a final class that can be
neither implemented nor doubled, so neither name works on both. The lookup moves
into a fixture, where it is written once and out of the analyser's way, the same
shape ParserFactoryBridge uses for the two php-parser majors. basePath() becomes
static because the declaration reader needs it before there is an instance.

#[CoversNothing] sat on testDocblockExample(). PHPUnit 12 deprecates carrying it
on a method and 13 stops reading it there, so with failOnAllIssues the parallel
job counted sixteen deprecations. It moves to DoctestSuite, the class PHPUnit
actually runs; PHPUnit reads class metadata from the class it runs rather than
from what that class extends, so DoctestRunner says in its docblock that a
subclass carries it.

The scanners, the extractor, and the provider declared iterable and returned
generators. iterator_to_array() only takes a plain iterable from PHP 8.2, so on
the 8.0 floor PHPStan reported twenty-one calls in the doctest tests as passing
something that is not Traversable — correctly, since the declared type admitted
an array. They declare Generator, which is what they were already returning.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

=== 95c09b5
Declare the doctest classes the example rules now run

RequireExampleOnPublicApiRule used to read examples through DocGen's extractor

git commit -F - <<'MSG'
Configure doc-gen from its command line, and drop the file it read

doc.yaml was a second place to say what a run documents, and the wrong place
for half of it. The address a site is published at, the revision a preview
compares against, and the worker count a job can spare are known by the run
rather than by the repository, so a checked-in file could only ever hold the
value of one deployment while every other caller overrode it from the command
line anyway. Nothing here was a setting the file was better at holding, so the
file goes and the options carry all of it.

Every key it had is now an option: --packages, --exclude, --title, --deptrac,
and --repository join the ones that already overrode it, `cache: false` is
--no-cache, and a list option reads a comma-separated value and may be
repeated, which adds to what the earlier occurrences named. That last part is
what lets a composer script hold what a project always documents and the job
that calls it add what only it knows: `composer doc-gen -- --base-url=…`.

DocGenConfigFactory builds the configuration out of the parsed arguments, in
place of ConfigLoader, its two YAML readers, the path resolver, and the
overrides that reconciled a file with a command line. The project root is the
directory the command ran in rather than the directory a config file sat in.
Messages that named a key now name the option: `Invalid --base-url value: …`,
`Invalid --repository value: …`, and the discovery error asks for --packages.

This repository keeps its own settings in the `doc-gen` composer script and
lets the Docs workflow pass --base-url derived from GITHUB_REPOSITORY, which is
also how both workflow templates the skill ships are written now.
